name: Stack
usage: Stacking blocks, form fields and lists vertically; replaces hand-written layout classes and layout CSS

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, as a spacing step.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted.

props.name: justify
props.description: Vertical distribution of the children (takes effect when the container has spare height).

props.name: grow
props.description: Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Scrolls inside this container when the content overflows (and lets the container shrink).

props.name: as
props.description: HTML element to render, for semantics (`ul` / `li` for lists, `section` for page regions, and so on).
